"The Maxims" by François de La Rochefoucauld is a collection of aphorisms that offers insights into human nature and conduct, reflecting on the complexities of self-love and virtue. Written in the 17th century, the work is structured around brief, witty statements that often reveal uncomfortable truths about human motivations and behavior.
